title: The Babington cipher
alt: Two handwritten pages. Above: lines of cipher symbols. Below: a key that pairs each letter from a to z, and some common words, with a cipher symbol, signed Anthonie Babington.
author: Thomas Phelippes and Anthony Babington

description: Composite image of forged postscript to a letter by Mary Queen of Scots to Anthony Babington (SP 12/193/54) and alongside Babington's record of the cipher used. (SP 53/18/55)
